response.text:
{"criterion": "Actions taken across the bundle's periods match the stated priorities, and no buyback in those periods was made at a price the filings later show was high (a window with no buybacks meets this condition).", "why": "SCOPE. ASSUMPTION-0: the bundle is one 10-Q (Q3 FY2025 and the nine months ended 2025-05-29, with FY2024 comparatives); every judgement below is confined to that window, and no multi-year allocation record exists here to judge.

WHERE THE CASH WENT (nine months ended 2025-05-29, FY2024 comparative second)
F1 [ca.capex] "Expenditures for property, plant, and equipment | (10,199) | (5,266)" (millions).
F2 [ca.capex] "Proceeds from government incentives | 1,294 | 267".
F3 [ca.dividend] "Payments of dividends to shareholders | (392) | (384)".
F4 [ca.issuance] "Proceeds from issuance of debt 4,430 | 999"; F5 [ca.issuance] "Repayments of debt | (3,604) | (1,816)", MD&A: the repayments "included the prepayment of the 2026 Notes, 2026 Term Loan A, 2027 Notes, and 2027 Term Loan A borrowings".
F6 [ca.buyback] "No shares were repurchased in the first nine months of 2025."
F7 [ca.acquisition] status not_found — the bundle discloses no business combination; investing activities are described as "primarily of $10.20 billion of expenditures for property, plant, and equipment; partially offset by $1.29 billion received from government incentives".
INFERENCE-1 (F1,F3,F4,F5,F6): within this window the order of magnitude is reinvestment first, debt refinancing second (issuance and repayment of comparable size, with near maturities prepaid), dividend third, buyback zero, acquisitions zero.
DATA GAP: I am not permitted to compute proportions; the bundle supplies no <computed_metrics> block, so no percentage split of uses of cash, no net nine-month capex figure (only the gross F1 and the incentives F2 separately), and no free-cash-flow measure. Treat the ordering above as ordinal, not as percentages.

★ BUYBACK PRICE DISCIPLINE
F6 above; F8 [ca.buyback] Q3: "During the quarter ended May 29, 2025, we did not repurchase any common stock under the authorization and as of May 29, 2025, $2.81 billion of the authorization remained available". F9 [ca.buyback] cumulative since the 2018 authorisation: "Through May 29, 2025, we had repurchased an aggregate of $7.19 billion under the authorization."
F10 [ca.buyback] The only shares taken in during Q3 were tax withholdings: "March 28, 2025 | – | April 24, 2025 | 38,763 | 70.20 | —", and the equity statement shows "Repurchase of stock – withholdings on employee equity awards (1) | — | (5) | (34) | — | — | (39)".
INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE (price-discipline test): needed — a per-period repurchase price series and the price range of the period. why — the bundle contains no price range for any period (its omission of price is a stated design decision) and, more decisively, contains zero discretionary repurchases to test. would_change — if the bundle had shown open-market repurchases in these periods at an average price at or near the period high, the rubric's second clause would fail and I would drop a level; if it had shown repurchases at or near the period low, the level chosen here would be unchanged but better evidenced.
INFERENCE-2 (F6,F8): the rubric's parenthetical — "a window with no buybacks meets this condition" — is satisfied literally and without interpretation.

ACQUISITIONS
F11 [ca.acquisition, ca.divestiture] both not_found; balance sheet "Goodwill | 1,150 | 1,150" as of 2025-05-29 and 2024-08-29.
INFERENCE-3 (F7,F11): there is no acquisition to score and no goodwill movement, therefore no impairment marking in this window. Nothing here is evidence of acquisition skill either way.

REINVESTMENT QUALITY
F12 [seg.op_income] CNBU nine-month operating income "$5,812" (FY2025) against "$73" (FY2024); F13 [sc.sbc_revenue_note] revenue "26,063" vs "17,361" nine months.
DATA GAP: no incremental-return series is supplied and I will not derive one; the change in profit above sits beside a doubling of capex (F1) but the filing attributes results to price and mix — MD&A: DRAM sales rose "primarily due to a high-40% range increase in average selling prices". So the profit change cannot be assigned to the capital deployed.
F14 [cp.statement] on whether there is anywhere left to deploy: "To support projected memory demand in the second half of the decade, we will need to add new DRAM wafer capacity"; F15 [cp.commitment] "up to four fabs to be built over the next 20-plus years" in Clay, New York; F16 [gd.value] "total CHIPS Act grants of up to $6.4 billion"; F17 [gd.value] "up to $5.5 billion" under a New York "non-binding term sheet" [gd.language_note]. INFERENCE-4 (F14–F17): the stated reinvestment runway is long-dated and part-funded by incentives that the filing itself conditions — "Funding of certain significant capital projects is also dependent on the receipt of government incentives, which are subject to various conditions and may not be obtained" [cp.condition].

DILUTION
F18 [sc.basic] basic weighted-average shares nine months "1,114" (FY2025) vs "1,104" (FY2024); F19 [sc.diluted] diluted "1,123" vs "1,104"; F20 [sc.end_of_period] "1,119,125,101" outstanding as of June 18, 2025, against balance-sheet "1,253 shares issued and 1,109 outstanding as of August 29, 2024"; F21 [sc.sbc_expense] stock-based compensation "$263 | $217 | $713 | $608"; F22 [gd.value] "$1.73 billion of total unrecognized compensation costs for unvested awards".
INFERENCE-5 (F6,F18,F19,F20,F21): the share count rose, no buyback offset it, and the cash outflow tagged "repurchase" (F10) is tax withholding on vesting rather than share retirement. This is real dilution, and it is the weakest part of the record — but it is not the lower rubric option, because that option requires buybacks to have been "claimed" while issuance funded compensation, and the filing claims no buybacks at all (F6, F8).

★ SAID VERSUS DID (E-12)
1. Capex "approximately $14 billion" FY2025 net of incentives [cp.statement/cp.commitment] — NOT YET TESTABLE. The bundle stops at nine months, gives gross capex (F1) and incentives received (F2) as separate lines, and I may not net them; the fourth quarter is outside the bundle. The commitment is explicitly conditioned: "Actual amounts for 2025 will vary depending on market conditions" [cp.condition].
2. Buyback authorisation [cp.statement] — KEPT as stated, because what was stated was discretion, not intent: "The repurchase authorization has no expiration date, does not obligate us to acquire any common stock, and is subject to market conditions, restrictions applicable under our CHIPS Act direct funding agreements" [cp.condition]; no repurchases occurred (F6, F8) and $2.81bn remains.
3. Quarterly dividend $0.115 [cp.commitment] — KEPT: "We declared and paid dividends of $0.115 per share in the first, second, and third quarters of 2025" [ca.dividend], cash paid $392m (F3), and declared again "On June 25, 2025" [ca.dividend]. Consistent with the CHIPS constraint permitting "customary and ordinary course recurring dividends".
4. Fab expansion [cp.statement/cp.commitment] — KEPT so far as observable: capex nearly doubled year on year (F1) and construction in progress rose to "4,937" from "3,444" [balance-sheet PP&E table]; milestone dates ("first DRAM wafer output projected in the second half of calendar 2027" [gd.value]) are outside the bundle and untestable here.
5. "We continue to prudently manage our NAND supply, including the levels of our capital investment" [cp.statement] — NOT TESTABLE: cp.commitment is status not_found, i.e. "No figure, ratio or date attached to this statement anywhere in MD&A", and capex is not disclosed by segment ("We do not identify or report internally our assets (other than goodwill) or capital expenditures by segment" [seg.assets]).

WHY NOT THE ADJACENT LEVELS
Down one ("broadly match, with one departure the filings explain"): I can find no departure in this window to explain. The nearest candidate — cash out under a line captioned "Repurchase of stock" — is disclosed as withholding on vesting (F10) and Part II Item 2 states the authorisation was untouched (F8), so it is not a departure from the stated buyback posture.
Down two ("priorities stated and actions do not clearly follow"): contradicted by F1–F6 against F14 and the dividend commitment.
Lowest ("deployed against the stated priorities, or issuance funded compensation while buybacks were claimed"): the second limb needs buybacks to have been claimed; F6 and F8 say none were made.
"Bundle does not disclose capital-allocation actions": contradicted by ca.capex being present and populated (F1).", "what_would_move_it_down": "A repurchase table covering these same periods showing open-market buying under the $10 billion authorisation — rather than the "No shares were repurchased in the first nine months of 2025" the bundle contains — at an average price the filings later mark as elevated, would break the no-buyback condition and move me to "Actions broadly match stated priorities, with one departure the filings explain.""}
